Correction to v0.1.81's vanilla mode.

## Server

### Fixed
- Vanilla identity mode on a world that ran the synthetic keying before: when no record exists under the blank id, the newest record under a synthetic id is promoted to the blank profile instead of leaving the game to make an empty one, and every other record except the host's own is retired (id and name), since any record carrying a machine name is a potential decoy for the game's name-keyed follow-up.
